import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
d = df.dropna(subset=['steps_k','recovery_score']).copy()
# robust
m = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ steps_k + C(hospital)', data=d).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print('HC3 steps_k', m.params['steps_k'], m.pvalues['steps_k'])
# bootstrap
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
coefs=[]
for _ in range(2000):
    s=d.sample(len(d),replace=True)
    coefs.append(smf.ols('recovery_score ~ steps_k + C(hospital)',data=s).fit().params['steps_k'])
coefs=np.array(coefs)
print('boot mean',coefs.mean(),'ci',np.percentile(coefs,[2.5,97.5]),'p>0',(coefs<=0).mean())
# hdl
d2=df.dropna(subset=['hdl','recovery_score'])
m2=smf.ols('recovery_score ~ hdl + C(hospital)',data=d2).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print('HC3 hdl', m2.params['hdl'], m2.pvalues['hdl'])
